tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Holded API key and connectivity by making a lightweight request to the contacts endpoint.

tools.name: list-contacts
tools.description: List contacts from Holded. Returns a curated list of contacts with id, name, email, phone, and other key fields. Supports pagination via page and limit.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

type.description: Filter by contact type (e.g. client, supplier, lead)

tools.name: get-contact
tools.description: Get a single contact from Holded by its ID. Returns full contact details including name, email, phone, address, VAT number, and custom fields.

tools.name: create-contact
tools.description: Create a new contact in Holded.

tools.name: update-contact
tools.description: Update an existing contact in Holded by its ID.

tools.name: delete-contact
tools.description: Delete a contact from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: search-contacts
tools.description: Search contacts in Holded by name. Returns matching contacts with key fields mapped to a curated output.

tools.name: list-contact-groups
tools.description: List contact groups from Holded. Contact groups are used to organize contacts into categories or segments. Supports pagination via page and limit.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

tools.name: get-contact-group
tools.description: Get a single contact group from Holded by its ID. Returns the group details including its member contacts.

tools.name: create-contact-group
tools.description: Create a new contact group in Holded.

contactIds.description: List of contact IDs to add to this group

tools.name: update-contact-group
tools.description: Update an existing contact group in Holded by its ID.

contactIds.description: List of contact IDs to set for this group (replaces existing)

tools.name: delete-contact-group
tools.description: Delete a contact group from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: list-tags
tools.description: List all tags from Holded. Tags can be applied to contacts, documents, and other entities for categorization.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

tools.name: create-tag
tools.description: Create a new tag in Holded. Tags are used for categorizing contacts, documents, and other entities.

tools.name: delete-tag
tools.description: Delete a tag from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: list-invoices
tools.description: List invoices from Holded. Returns a curated list of invoices with id, number, date, contact, total, status, and payment info. Supports pagination.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

status.description: Filter by invoice status (e.g. draft, sent, paid, completed)

tools.name: get-invoice
tools.description: Get a single invoice from Holded by its ID, including line items and full details.

tools.name: create-invoice
tools.description: Create a new invoice in Holded.

contactId.description: Contact ID for the invoice recipient

taxes.description: Array of tax objects (alternative to single tax rate)

tags.description: Tags to assign to the invoice

tools.name: update-invoice
tools.description: Update an existing invoice in Holded by its ID. All fields are optional.

contactId.description: Contact ID for the invoice recipient

tags.description: Tags to assign to the invoice

tools.name: delete-invoice
tools.description: Delete an invoice from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: cancel-invoice
tools.description: Cancel an invoice in Holded by its ID. This changes the invoice status to cancelled.

tools.name: approve-invoice
tools.description: Approve an invoice in Holded by its ID. This moves a draft invoice to approved/sent status.

tools.name: send-invoice
tools.description: Send an invoice to the contact via email from Holded. Defaults to the contact's email if no email is provided.

email.description: Override recipient email address (defaults to contact email)

message.description: Custom message to include in the email body

tools.name: find-invoices
tools.description: Search invoices in Holded by document number. Returns matching invoices with key fields.

documentNumber.description: The invoice document number to search for (e.g. INV-2026-001)

tools.name: get-invoice-pdf
tools.description: Download the PDF of an invoice from Holded. Returns the PDF as a base64-encoded string with a filename.

tools.name: list-estimates
tools.description: List estimates (quotes) from Holded. Returns estimates with id, number, date, contact, total, and status. Supports pagination.

limit.description: Results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

status.description: Filter by status (e.g. draft, sent, accepted, rejected)

tools.name: get-estimate
tools.description: Get a single estimate from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: create-estimate
tools.description: Create a new estimate (quote) in Holded.

tools.name: list-proformas
tools.description: List proformas from Holded. Supports pagination and filtering.

limit.description: Results per page (default: 25)

status.description: Filter by status (e.g. draft, sent, accepted, rejected)

tools.name: get-proforma
tools.description: Get a single proforma from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: list-credit-notes
tools.description: List credit notes from Holded. Supports pagination and filtering.

limit.description: Results per page (default: 25)

tools.name: get-credit-note
tools.description: Get a single credit note from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: list-recurring-invoices
tools.description: List recurring invoices from Holded. Supports pagination.

limit.description: Results per page (default: 25)

tools.name: get-recurring-invoice
tools.description: Get a single recurring invoice from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: list-sales-receipts
tools.description: List sales receipts from Holded. Supports pagination.

limit.description: Results per page (default: 25)

status.description: Filter by status (e.g. draft, sent, paid)

tools.name: list-services
tools.description: List services from Holded. Services are non-physical sellable items.

limit.description: Results per page (default: 25)

tools.name: list-sales-channels
tools.description: List sales channels from Holded. Sales channels track different distribution sources.

tools.name: list-numbering-series
tools.description: List numbering series from Holded for a specific document type. Numbering series define document numbering patterns per type.

documentType.description: Document type to list numbering series for (e.g. invoice, salesreceipt, creditnote, estimate, proform, waybill, salesorder, purchase, purchaserefund, order, purchaseshipment, receiptnote, productionorder)

tools.name: list-products
tools.description: List products from Holded. Returns a curated list of products with id, name, SKU, price, cost price, stock, category, type, and tax info. Supports pagination via page and limit.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

tools.name: get-product
tools.description: Get a single product from Holded by its ID. Returns full product details including price, cost price, stock, category, type, unit type, and tax info.

tools.name: create-product
tools.description: Create a new product in Holded.

unit_type.description: Unit of measure (e.g. pcs, kg, hours)

tools.name: update-product
tools.description: Update an existing product in Holded by its ID. All fields are optional.

tools.name: delete-product
tools.description: Delete a product from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: list-warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses from Holded. Warehouses are storage locations for product inventory. Supports pagination via page and limit.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

tools.name: get-warehouse
tools.description: Get a single warehouse from Holded by its ID. Returns warehouse details including name, address, and default status.

tools.name: list-price-lists
tools.description: List price lists from Holded. Price lists define custom pricing tiers for different customer segments. Supports pagination via page and limit.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

tools.name: get-price-list
tools.description: Get a single price list from Holded by its ID, including the full list of product prices.

tools.name: list-accounting-accounts
tools.description: List accounting accounts (chart of accounts) from Holded. Returns accounts with id, code, name, group, and balance.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

group.description: Filter by account group (e.g. assets, liabilities, equity, income, expenses)

tools.name: list-ledger-entries
tools.description: List ledger entries from Holded. Returns journal entries with date, account, debit/credit amounts, and description. If no date range is provided, defaults to the current calendar year.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

endDate.description: Filter entries up to this date (ISO 8601)

tools.name: list-expenses-accounts
tools.description: List expenses accounts from Holded. These are accounts used for tracking business expenses.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

tools.name: get-expenses-account
tools.description: Get a single expenses account from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: list-payments
tools.description: List payments from Holded. Returns payments with id, date, amount, contact, method, and related document info.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

endDate.description: Filter payments up to this date (ISO 8601)

tools.name: get-payment
tools.description: Get a single payment from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: create-payment
tools.description: Create a new payment in Holded. Payments can be linked to invoices or other documents.

contactId.description: Contact ID the payment is associated with

documentType.description: Type of related document (e.g. invoice, expense)

tools.name: update-payment
tools.description: Update an existing payment in Holded by its ID.

tools.name: delete-payment
tools.description: Delete a payment from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: list-taxes
tools.description: List taxes from Holded. Returns tax rates with id, name, percentage, and type.

tools.name: list-purchases
tools.description: List purchases from Holded. Returns purchase records with id, number, date, supplier, total, and status. Supports pagination.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

contactId.description: Filter purchases by supplier contact ID

status.description: Filter by purchase status (e.g. draft, sent, paid)

tools.name: get-purchase
tools.description: Get a single purchase from Holded by its ID, including line items and full details.

tools.name: create-purchase
tools.description: Create a new purchase (supplier invoice) in Holded. Requires an existing supplier contactId and at least one item. Returns the created purchase with its id.

contactId.description: Supplier contact ID (required — must be an existing contact)

taxes.description: Array of tax IDs (e.g. ["s_iva_21"]) applied to this item

tags.description: Tags to assign to the purchase

tools.name: update-purchase
tools.description: Update an existing purchase in Holded by its ID. All fields are optional.

taxes.description: Array of tax IDs (e.g. ["s_iva_21"]) applied to this item

tags.description: Tags to assign to the purchase

tools.name: delete-purchase
tools.description: Delete a purchase from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: attach-purchase-file
tools.description: Attach a file (e.g. the supplier invoice PDF) to a Holded purchase. Uploads real multipart/form-data with the file under the `file` field — max 10 MB. Provide either dataUrl (data:<mime>;base64,<payload>) or a raw base64 string, plus a filename. Returns the attachment info.

contentType.description: MIME type (e.g. 'application/pdf'). Defaults from dataUrl or octet-stream.

dataUrl.description: Data URI scheme — exact format `data:<mime>;base64,<base64Payload>`. Either this or base64 is required.

base64.description: Raw base64-encoded file content. Either this or dataUrl is required.

tools.name: list-purchase-attachments
tools.description: List files attached to a Holded purchase by its ID.

tools.name: list-banking-accounts
tools.description: List banking accounts from Holded. Returns bank accounts with id, name, bank, IBAN, balance, and currency.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

tools.name: get-banking-account
tools.description: Get a single banking account from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: list-banking-movements
tools.description: List banking movements for a specific Holded bank account. Returns transactions with date, amount, description, and reconciliation status.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

endDate.description: Filter movements up to this date (ISO 8601)

type.description: Filter movements by type: income or expense

tools.name: list-payment-methods
tools.description: List payment methods from Holded. Payment methods define how invoices and payments are processed.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

tools.name: get-payment-method
tools.description: Get a single payment method from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: list-remittances
tools.description: List remittances from Holded. Remittances are batch payment collections (typically SEPA direct debits).

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

status.description: Filter by remittance status (e.g. draft, sent, processed)

tools.name: get-remittance
tools.description: Get a single remittance from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: list-funnels
tools.description: List CRM funnels from Holded. Funnels represent sales pipelines with stages that leads move through.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

tools.name: get-funnel
tools.description: Get a single CRM funnel from Holded by its ID, including its stages.

tools.name: list-leads
tools.description: List CRM leads from Holded. Returns leads with id, name, email, phone, stage, funnel, and value. Supports pagination and filtering by funnel and stage.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

tools.name: get-lead
tools.description: Get a single CRM lead from Holded by its ID, with full detail including description, tags, and custom fields.

tools.name: create-lead
tools.description: Create a new CRM lead in Holded.

funnelId.description: Funnel ID to place the lead in

expectedCloseDate.description: Expected close date (ISO date string, e.g. 2026-12-31)

tags.description: Tags to assign to the lead

tools.name: update-lead
tools.description: Update an existing CRM lead in Holded by its ID. All fields are optional — only provided fields are updated.

tags.description: Tags to assign to the lead

tools.name: update-lead-stage
tools.description: Move a CRM lead to a different stage within its funnel. This is the primary action for advancing leads through the sales pipeline.

stageId.description: The target stage ID to move the lead to

tools.name: list-projects
tools.description: List projects from Holded. Returns a curated list of projects with id, name, description, status, budget, dates, and contact. Supports pagination via page and limit.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

tools.name: get-project
tools.description: Get a single project from Holded by its ID. Returns full project details including name, description, status, budget, dates, and contact.

tools.name: get-project-summary
tools.description: Get a summary of a Holded project including financial and time metrics such as budget usage, total time, and task counts.

tools.name: list-tasks
tools.description: List tasks from Holded. Returns tasks with id, name, status, assignee, project, and dates. Supports filtering by project and status, plus pagination.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

status.description: Filter by task status (e.g. todo, in_progress, done)

tools.name: get-task
tools.description: Get a single task from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: create-task
tools.description: Create a new task in Holded.

projectId.description: ID of the project this task belongs to

assigneeId.description: ID of the assigned team member

tools.name: list-project-time-entries
tools.description: List time entries for a specific Holded project. Returns time entries with id, date, duration, user, and task info. Supports date range filtering and pagination.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by the previous response. Omit to start from the first page.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 200)

startDate.description: Filter entries on or after this date (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD)

endDate.description: Filter entries on or before this date (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: list-all-time-entries
tools.description: List all time entries across all Holded projects. Returns time entries with id, date, duration, user, task, and project info. Cursor-paginated: pass the cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by the previous response. Omit to start from the first page.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 200)

tools.name: list-employees
tools.description: List employees from Holded. Returns a curated list with id, name, email, phone, department, position, status, startDate, and timestamps. Supports pagination.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

tools.name: get-employee
tools.description: Get a single employee from Holded by their ID. Returns full employee details including name, email, phone, department, position, status, and dates.

tools.name: list-employee-time-entries
tools.description: List time tracking entries for a specific Holded employee. Returns clock-in/out records with dates and durations. Supports date range filtering and pagination.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by the previous response. Omit to start from the first page.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 200)

startDate.description: Filter entries on or after this date (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD)

endDate.description: Filter entries on or before this date (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: list-all-employee-time-entries
tools.description: List time tracking entries across all Holded employees. Returns clock-in/out records with dates and durations. Cursor-paginated: pass the cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by the previous response. Omit to start from the first page.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 200)

tools.name: list-payslips
tools.description: List payslips from Holded. Returns a curated list with id, employee, period, gross/net amounts, and status. Supports filtering by employee, status, and period, plus pagination.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

status.description: Filter by payslip status (e.g. draft, approved, paid)

period.description: Filter by pay period (e.g. 2026-01 for January 2026)

tools.name: get-payslip
tools.description: Get a single payslip from Holded by its ID. Returns full payslip details including employee, period, gross/net amounts, deductions, taxes, and status.

tools.name: list-time-off-requests
tools.description: List time-off requests from Holded. Returns a curated list with id, employee, type, dates, and approval status. Supports filtering by employee, status, and type, plus pagination.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 50)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. Pass the cursor value to get the next page.

employeeId.description: Filter by employee ID. When provided, queries the per-employee endpoint.

status.description: Filter by approval status (e.g. pending, accepted, rejected, cancelled)

timeOffTypeId.description: Filter by time-off type ID (e.g. holiday, sick leave, vacation)

teamId.description: Filter by team ID (account-wide endpoint only)

startDateFrom.description: Start date lower bound (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-01-01). Required by the API. Defaults to the start of the current year.

startDateTo.description: Start date upper bound (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-12-31). Required by the API. Defaults to the end of the current year.

tools.name: get-time-off-request
tools.description: Get a single time-off request from Holded by its ID. Returns full details including employee, type, dates, days, approval status, and approver info.

employeeId.description: The Holded employee ID (24-character hex ObjectId)

id.description: The Holded time-off request ID (24-character hex ObjectId)

tools.name: list-events
tools.description: List calendar events from Holded. Returns events with id, title, start/end dates, all-day flag, location, and attendees. Supports pagination and date range filtering.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

startDate.description: Filter events starting from this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01)

endDate.description: Filter events ending before this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-12-31)

tools.name: get-event
tools.description: Get a single calendar event from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: create-event
tools.description: Create a new calendar event in Holded. Requires a title, start date, and end date.

allDay.description: Whether this is an all-day event

tools.name: list-inbox-documents
tools.description: List inbox documents from Holded. The inbox contains documents received from external sources. Returns documents with id, name, status, type, and timestamps. Supports pagination and status filtering.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

status.description: Filter by document status (e.g. pending, processed, rejected)

tools.name: get-inbox-document
tools.description: Get a single inbox document from Holded by its ID.

tools.name: get-api-usage
tools.description: Get API usage statistics for the current Holded account. Shows request counts, rate limit info, and overall usage.

startDate.description: Start date for usage period (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01)

endDate.description: End date for usage period (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-12-31)

tools.name: get-api-usage-by-type
tools.description: Get API usage statistics broken down by a specific type (e.g. "requests", "errors"). Returns usage details for the given type.

type.description: The usage type to filter by (e.g. "requests", "errors")

startDate.description: Start date for usage period (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01)

endDate.description: End date for usage period (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-12-31)

tools.name: list-webhooks
tools.description: List all webhooks configured in Holded. Webhooks are HTTP callbacks that notify your application when events occur.

tools.name: get-webhook
tools.description: Get a single webhook from Holded by its ID. Returns full webhook details including URL, subscribed events, and enabled status.

tools.name: create-webhook
tools.description: Create a new webhook in Holded. The webhook will receive HTTP POST callbacks for the specified events at the given URL.

url.description: The URL where webhook events will be delivered (must be HTTPS)

events.description: Array of event types to subscribe to (e.g. ["contact.created", "invoice.paid"]). Use list-webhook-events to see available events.

tools.name: update-webhook
tools.description: Update an existing webhook in Holded. Can modify the URL, subscribed events, or enabled status.

url.description: The new URL where webhook events will be delivered (must be HTTPS)

events.description: New array of event types to subscribe to

tools.name: delete-webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook from Holded by its ID. This permanently removes the webhook and stops all event deliveries to its URL.

tools.name: list-webhook-events
tools.description: List all supported webhook event types in Holded. Use this to discover which events you can subscribe to when creating or updating webhooks.
